message.subject: Reschedule my knee follow-up
message.body_html:
Hello,

I have a follow-up on Wednesday, November 4 at 9:00 AM, but I have a conflict that morning. Could we move it to Tuesday, November 3 at 2:00 PM?

Thank you,
Barnaby Gourdsworth
